key_terms.قُعُودٌ: sitting (plural or dual form indicating a group sitting)

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'As they sat around it' refer to in Surah Al-Buruj?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this posture of 'sitting' (qu'ud) signifies a state of passive resignation and eternal stagnation, contrasting with the active worship of the righteous. It underscores the finality of their rejection, where they remain fixed in their error without the capacity for repentance or movement toward divine mercy. This imagery serves as a powerful reminder of the spiritual paralysis that results from clinging to false idols or worldly attachments.
